name: Tulikettu
body:
TULIKETTU
CR 9/MR 3

A giant foxlike beast runs at great speed, without sound, on the soft, starlit snow. Its tail leaves a multicolored trail of ever-changing hues in the air behind.

XP 6,400
CG Large magical beast (cold, mythic)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, snow vision M; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 15, flat-footed 18 (+6 armor, +6 Dex, +3 natural, -1 size)
hp 115 (9d10+66)
Fort +10, Ref +12, Will +8
Defensive Abilities coat of many stars +6 (8 hours/day); DR 5/epic M; Immune blinding effects, cold; Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 100 ft. (good), icewalking
Melee bite +15 (1d8+6 +1d6 cold), tail sweep +14 (1d8+6 +1d6 cold)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks dazzling tail, mythic power (3/day, surge +1d6), spray of shooting stars 2/day (DC 20, 8d4 cold damage)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 9th; concentration +15)

Constant—dancing lights
At will—faerie fire, ray of frost
1/day—wall of ice (DC 20)

Oracle Spells Known (CL 8th; concentration +14)

4th (4/day)—cure critical wounds, frosty aura, rainbow pattern (DC 22)
3rd (6/day)—cure serious wounds, daylight, magic circle against evil, silverlight (DC 19)
2nd (8/day)—blessing of courage and life, cure moderate wounds, burst of radiance (DC 18), flickering lights (DC 18), hypnotic pattern (DC 20)
1st (8/day)—bless, brightest night, color spray (DC 19), cure light wounds, protection from evil, sanctuary (DC 17), starsight
0 (at will)—create water, grasp, guidance, light, resistance, spark, vigor, virtue

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 23, Con 18, Int 20, Wis 17, Cha 23
Base Atk +9, CMB +15, CMD 28 (32 vs. trip)
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Iron Will, Spell Focus (illusion) MF, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +18 (+22 when jumping), Fly +20, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +15, Stealth +14, Survival +12 (+16 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Survival when tracking by scent
Languages Aquan, Celestial, Common, Sylvan
SQ awesome display, mythic magic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dazzling Tail (Su)

Any creature damaged by a tulikettu’s tail sweep is permanently blinded (DC 20 Fortitude partial); creatures succeeding on the save are instead dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

ECOLOGY

Environment arctic
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard

A tulikettu casts spells and gains mystery spells and revelations as a 8th-level oracle with the Heavens mystery but doesn’t gain an oracle curse or the mystery’s skills.

Every appearance of eldritch northern lights in arctic skies may be due to the joyous running and frolicking of tulikettus, also called tulirepo, tulikko, revontulet, or simply “fire foxes” or “aurora foxes.” These good-natured and cheerful creatures roam through the tundra expanses at night, rejoicing of starlight, moonlight and icy winds and storms. They love music, songs and the reciting of ancient sagas, and can offer their friendship and help to talented skalds in the wilderness. A tulikettu’s fur can be of a rich red-auburn, deep midnight blackish-blue, or completely shining white. Its tail’s luminous trail has the same effect of a constant dancing lights spell, whether the beast is still or in motion.
